mapper.select: SELECT l.like_id as likeId, l.user_id as userId, l.target_id as targetId, l.created_at as createdAt, l.target_type as targetType, a.article_id as articleId, a.title, a.cover_image as coverImage, a.created_at as articleCreatedAt, a.content, a.view_count as viewCount, a.like_count as likeCount, a.comment_count as commentCount FROM `likes` l INNER JOIN articles a ON l.target_id = a.article_id WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} AND l.target_type = 1 ORDER BY l.created_at DESC
